description: This file defines the 'Note' domain model class and the 'SyncStatus' enum for a notes application, capturing note details, synchronization status, and providing a copyWith method for immutability.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Domain model representing a note with properties such as id, title, content, timestamps, delete status, and sync status.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the 'Note' object with optional new values for its fields, enabling immutable updates.
